question: After applying successive discounts of 10% and 5% on the marked price of an article, it was sold ₹3,420. Find the marked price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

Discount₁ = 10%

Discount₂ = 5%

Selling Price (S.P) = ₹3,420

Calculation:

In First Case :

Discount1 = 10% = -1/10

Let the M.P (Marked Price) be 10 units

Then S.P = 10-1 = 9 units.

In Second Case :

Discount2 = 5% = -1/20

Let the M.P (Marked Price) be 20 units

Then S.P = 20 - 1 = 19 units.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b6649c9627f7cdd492cbd3f06580e93502b073cc6930361070ffcc04ddf3f73.png] 

The Marked Price of the article is ₹ 4000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 

Discount (x) = 10 %

Discount (y) = 5 %

Selling Price (S.P) = ₹3,420

**Formula Used:** 

Successive discount for 2 terms = - x - y + (x × y)/100 

S.P = M.P × Discount%

**Calculation:**

⇒ -10 - 5 + (10 × 5)/100

⇒ -15 + 50/100

⇒ -15 + .5

⇒ -14.5 %

Final Discount % = 100 - 14.5 

⇒ 85.5 .

S.P = (M.P × 85.5)/100

⇒ 3420 = (M.P × 85.5)/100

M.P = ₹ 4000

∴ **The Marked Price of the article is ₹ 4000.**
